title: Testing Deep Learning Library APIs via Cross-Framework Differential Fuzzing
abstract: arXiv:2608.11886v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Deep learning libraries underpin many safety- and reliability-critical applications, yet existing API-level testing techniques often rely on intra-library properties or CPU--GPU differential oracles and may miss defects that behave consistently across hardware backends. We present Xamt, a cross-framework differential fuzzing approach for deep learning library APIs. Xamt constructs and tests execution-validated groups of APIs intended to implement equivalent operations across seven libraries. It uses explicit API aliases and parameter-role normalization to construct candidate correspondences and validates them through pairwise execution and a group-level behavioral check on canonical ordinary inputs. The resulting groups are explored using variance-guided differential fuzzing with ordinary, boundary, and non-finite inputs. translated_title: 跨框架差分模糊测试深度学习库API
translated_abstract: 深度学习库支撑着许多安全和可靠性关键应用，然而现有的API级测试技术通常依赖库内部属性或CPU-GPU差分预言机，可能遗漏在硬件后端行为一致的缺陷。我们提出了Xamt，一种针对深度学习库API的跨框架差分模糊测试方法。Xamt构建并测试了跨七个库中旨在实现等效操作的API执行验证组。它使用显式API别名和参数角色归一化来构建候选对应关系，并通过成对执行和规范普通输入上的组级行为检查来验证它们。生成的组通过方差引导的差分模糊测试进行探索，包括普通、边界和非有限输入。崩溃和不一致预言机标记表现出异常终止或不一致输出的执行，以供后续分析。
tldr: 提出一种跨框架差分模糊测试方法Xamt，通过构建跨库API等效组并进行方差引导模糊测试，有效检测深度学习库API中的一致性和崩溃缺陷。
en_tdlr: Xamt proposes a cross-framework differential fuzzing approach that constructs execution-validated API groups across libraries and uses variance-guided fuzzing to detect consistency and crash defects in deep learning APIs.
